card.name: Word just before an expected 'have'
card.fires_on: A noun or quantifier right where the text is about to continue with a form of 'have' or 'has'. Examples are 'has no position', 'what plans he may have', 'at least 4 hours', 'patients with multiple'.

modes.label: Noun after no/what kind of
modes.description: A noun that is the object of possession, often followed by 'have' or 'in'.
modes.example: The author has no<< position>> in Maxwell Technologies and no plans to initiate

modes.label: Quantity or 'multiple' after with
modes.description: A quantity word in a 'patients with multiple...' or 'four or more' phrase.
modes.example: Elderly patients with<< multiple>> or serious co-morbidities who

modes.label: The verb have itself
modes.description: The word 'have' in an obligation phrase such as 'have to'.
modes.example: We<< have>> to leave by no later than 6

card.writes: It lowers the chance of 'have'-type words, mostly Chinese 有 forms, as the next word.
card.plain: It fires on words in a phrase where 'have' or 'has' would come next, such as 'no position' or 'multiple'.
